hook: Twenty-three linear algebra books, in reading order.

beats.say: Linear algebra is the mathematics of arrows and grids of numbers, of vectors and matrices, and the list calls it the most widely used mathematics there is.
A search engine ranks pages by finding one special vector of an enormous matrix, and every layer of a neural network is linear algebra too.
The twenty-three books come in five steps, from a first course to the books behind machine learning and scientific computing, and four of them are free.
